name: Specialized Medical Company
summary: Specialized Medical Company owns and operates hospitals, clinics, and medical centers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through Medical Services, and Pharmacies and Others segments. It provides diagnostic and therapeutic services for emergency medicine, cardiology, internal and family medicine, and pediatrics; and ancillary services, such as lab histopathology, diagnostic radiology and nuclear medicine, anesthesiology, pharmacy, and physiotherapy rehab.
